title: cargo_tree_outside_why reads / as outside the project, not as the filesystem root
body:
## Problem

`cargo_tree_outside_why` reads `/` as outside the project rather than as the filesystem root: helpers:1086 tidies `/` to the empty string, `cargo_place` returns 3 for it (:1131-1136), and the case at :1088 has no branch for 3, so `/`, `//` and `///` all come out "is outside the project". No caller reaches it today, because every caller asks `cargo_target_dir_why` first (fullcycle:772), which refuses `/` by name; the wrong answer is latent. Parked with 0150; fixed forward in the bundle on hv's word, 2026-10-03.

## Fix

`cargo_tree_outside_why` starts by asking `cargo_target_dir_why`, which replaces its own guard at :1077, and handles `cargo_place`'s 3 explicitly.

## Done when

1. Asked directly with `/`, the helper says "is the filesystem root"; red at 2ce9411.

## Resolution

Fixed at b3f37f92. `cargo_tree_outside_why` judges the value first, by asking `cargo_target_dir_why`, so one value has one verdict wherever it is asked. `/`, `//` and `///` now read "is the filesystem root, which the artefact check cannot examine as a build tree", and a relative value reads "is relative, and cargo reads it from the directory it runs in, which fullcycle cannot know", as every caller already said. The helper's own guard, which knew only "not absolute", is gone.

Only a 0 from `cargo_place` reaches the walk up to the project root. A 2 and a 1 keep their messages. Any other status, including the 3 that `/` used to reach, is named by its number ("cargo_place answered 3 ...") and is never walked to "outside the project".

A new arm in fullcycle.bats asks the helper directly with `/`, `//` and `///`. Driven red on f5334fa1, where all three read "is outside the project". The 0148 arm that asks with a relative path now expects `cargo_target_dir_why`'s words, and its title names 0166 as well. Three mutants each turn an aimed arm red: removing the value check, removing the `0)` branch, and restoring the old guard. Removing the branch for any other status survives, as declared: once the value check has passed a value, `cargo_place` can answer only 0, 1 or 2, so that branch cannot be reached today, and it stays as a guard for any status `cargo_place` may come to return.

Declared limit: a value that resolves to `/` through `.`, `..` or a link, such as `/.`, `/tmp/..` or a link to `/`, passes the value check, which reads the value as written, and then reads "resolves to /, outside the project". It is refused all the same, in other words.

The full suite on the landing tree, main with 0173 landed and this patch with 0169 v3, which shares lib/helpers and fullcycle.bats with it and landed just before it at ce72a4ff: 2070 of 2070 ok and 0 not ok (seal 20261005-1225, .errors empty), every landed blob equal to the suited tree's.
